main_alert_type: Multiple web server 400 error codes from same source ip
reference: On 24 Jan 2022 from 03:56 to 04:00 UTC, 172.19.131.174 scanned the intranet web server: 550 alerts for multiple 400 error codes from the same source on intranet-server port 80, together with Nmap user-agent detections, sshd scan attempts and requests for forbidden files. This is web reconnaissance (MITRE T1595.002) during the dirb and wpscan phases. Severity is critical; block 172.19.131.174 and review the exposed web paths.

main_alert_type: Web server 400 error code
reference: Between 03:56:53 and 03:58:12 UTC on 24 Jan 2022, the intranet-server web server logged 7089 HTTP 400 errors on port 80, almost all from 172.19.131.174. The burst of requests for missing pages is directory brute forcing and WordPress scanning (dirb, wpscan). Rate-limit or block the source and check which requested paths exist.

main_alert_type: Suricata: Alert - SURICATA TLS invalid record/traffic

main_alert_type: PAM: Login session opened
reference: At 04:37 to 04:38 UTC on 24 Jan 2022, on intranet-server, user jhall ran sudo to root, changed UID to root and opened root login sessions. main_alert_type: Multiple IDS alerts for same id

Repeated TLS related IDS hits can indicate tunnelling. Check the webserver outbound traffic and its DNS queries.

main_alert_type: Suricata: Alert - SURICATA HTTP unable to match response to request

main_alert_type: Multiple IDS alerts for same id
